prereq: Stage 1–2 的恢复、审批、幂等、回执和网页隔离已经稳定。
有一台可配对的专用桌面设备，明确哪些窗口、应用和文件范围允许操作。
GUI 任务可以在隔离桌面中运行，且用户能随时暂停和接管。
contracts: 设备能力
agentd 注册时声明窗口、文件、键鼠和应用能力；未声明的能力不可调用。
观察与接管
截图、可访问性树和窗口范围组成可审计观察；接管的输入必须暂停自动输入。
动作验证
每个 GUI 动作都有前后状态、窗口范围、截图/可访问性证据和半完成检测。
安全边界
密码库、系统安全设置、未列入白名单的应用和不可逆动作默认禁止。
高风险执行
不可逆或高影响桌面动作必须进入隔离桌面、二次确认和补偿/快照路径。
failures: 任务暂停并显示当前窗口截图和需要确认的元素。
重新定位、请求接管或调整白名单，不盲目点击坐标。
自动输入立即暂停，控制权交给用户。
等待用户交还并确认焦点、窗口和下一步。
任务显示“需要检查”，隐藏继续按钮并保留快照。
按补偿脚本或人工接管恢复，记录未完成影响。
exclusions: 不在无法观察、无法验证或无法接管时开放自动操作。
不读取密码库，不修改系统安全设置，不操作未授权窗口。
不把一次成功的坐标点击当成通用 GUI 能力。

prereq: Stage 1–2 recovery, approval, idempotency, receipts, and browser isolation are stable.
A dedicated desktop device can pair and has explicit allowed windows, applications, and file scopes.
GUI tasks run in an isolated desktop and users can pause and take over at any time.
contracts: Device capability
agentd declares window, file, keyboard, mouse, and app capabilities at registration; undeclared capabilities cannot be called.
Observation and takeover
Screenshots, accessibility tree, and window bounds form auditable observation; takeover pauses automatic input.
Action verification
Every GUI action has before/after state, bounds, screenshot/accessibility evidence, and half-complete detection.
Safety boundary
Password vaults, system security settings, non-allowlisted apps, and irreversible actions are denied by default.
High-risk execution
Irreversible or high-impact desktop actions require isolation, second confirmation, and a compensation/snapshot path.
failures: The task pauses with the current screenshot and the element that needs confirmation.
Relocate, request takeover, or adjust the allowlist; never click coordinates blindly.
Automatic input contends with the user
Automatic input pauses immediately and control goes to the user.
Wait for hand-back and confirm focus, window, and next step.
A high-risk action is half complete
The task shows Needs inspection, hides continue, and preserves the snapshot.
Recover with compensation or takeover and record the remaining impact.
exclusions: Do not automate when observation, verification, or takeover is unavailable.
Do not read password vaults, change system security settings, or operate unauthorized windows.
Do not treat one successful coordinate click as general GUI capability.

zh.title: 设备 agentd 与设备可见性
zh.lead: 先把桌面设备变成一个可识别、可授权、可撤销的执行节点，再谈 GUI 操作。
zh.outcome: 用户能看到一台可信桌面设备上线、具备哪些能力，以及当前是否可执行 GUI 任务。
steps: 实现设备配对、agentd 注册与设备身份存储。
建立能力目录，声明窗口、文件、键鼠和应用范围。
加入健康检查、本地权限声明和设备详情页。
实现断开、撤销和设备与任务关联审计。
能力不匹配时拒绝分配任务，并显示具体缺失能力。
验证 agentd 不能访问未声明能力，设备离线有明确状态。
zh.gate: 一台设备可注册、查看和撤销；能力不匹配时任务不分配；设备离线有明确状态；agentd 不能越权访问未声明能力。

en.title: Device agentd and visibility
en.lead: Turn a desktop into an identifiable, authorizable, revocable execution node before discussing GUI actions.
en.outcome: Users can see a trusted desktop come online, its capabilities, and whether it can currently run GUI tasks.
steps: Implement device pairing, agentd registration, and device identity storage.
Create a capability catalog for windows, files, keyboard, mouse, and applications.
Add health checks, local permission declarations, and a device detail page.
Implement disconnect, revocation, and audit linking devices to tasks.
Reject assignment when capabilities mismatch and show the missing capability.
Verify agentd cannot access undeclared capabilities and offline devices have explicit state.
en.gate: A device registers, is visible, and can be revoked; mismatched tasks are not assigned; offline devices have explicit state; agentd cannot exceed declared capability.

zh.title: GUI 观察与人工接管
zh.lead: 先让用户看得见、接得住，再让系统动手；观察和接管是任何自动 GUI 动作的前置条件。
zh.outcome: 用户能在 Hearth 中看到目标窗口，暂停自动流程，自己操作，然后交还或终止。
steps: 采集窗口范围、截图和可访问性树，形成最小必要观察。
实现只观察模式，明确不会发送键鼠输入。
提供实时接管界面，暂停自动输入并记录接管时间。
实现交还与终止流程，交还前记录焦点、窗口和下一步。
对截图中的敏感信息做脱敏，并写入审计事件。
验证接管不与自动输入争抢，用户知道需要自己完成什么。
zh.gate: 接管可用且不会与自动输入争抢；交还后任务状态明确；窗口范围正确；用户能看到需要自己完成什么；没有自动执行高风险动作。

en.title: GUI observation and human takeover
en.lead: Let users see and take control before the system acts; observation and takeover are prerequisites for any GUI automation.
en.outcome: Users can see the target window in Hearth, pause automation, operate manually, then hand back or terminate.
steps: Capture window bounds, screenshots, and accessibility tree as minimal necessary observation.
Implement observe-only mode with an explicit guarantee that no input is sent.
Provide live takeover that pauses automatic input and records takeover time.
Implement hand-back and terminate flows, recording focus, window, and next step.
Redact sensitive screenshot regions and write audit events.
Verify takeover never contends with automatic input and users know what they must do.
en.gate: Takeover works without input contention; hand-back leaves explicit task state; window bounds are correct; users know their required action; no high-risk action auto-runs.

zh.title: 低风险 GUI 动作与验证
zh.lead: 只在白名单应用和可验证范围内执行低风险动作，每次操作都留下前后状态证据。
zh.outcome: Hearth 能在白名单应用中完成打开文件、定位菜单、填写草稿和导出结果等低风险操作，并展示验证截图。
steps: 建立应用、窗口和动作白名单，默认拒绝未列出对象。
实现动作预览，显示目标窗口、元素、预期影响和回退方式。
加入键鼠、文件选择和窗口聚焦操作，并检测焦点变化。
操作后验证状态、截图和可访问性证据，检测半完成状态。
为失败增加重试、暂停、接管和人工确认入口。
至少用 3 个真实桌面任务验收，且不读取密码库、不改系统安全设置。
zh.gate: 至少 3 个真实桌面任务完成并验证；不读取密码库、不修改系统安全设置；每个动作有范围；失败可暂停或接管；UI 显示进度与证据。

en.title: Low-risk GUI actions and verification
en.lead: Run low-risk actions only inside allowlisted applications and verifiable bounds, with before/after evidence for every operation.
en.outcome: Hearth can open files, locate menus, fill drafts, and export results in allowlisted apps while showing verification screenshots.
steps: Create application, window, and action allowlists; deny anything not listed.
Implement action preview showing target window, element, expected impact, and rollback.
Add keyboard, mouse, file selection, and window-focus actions with focus-change detection.
Verify state, screenshots, and accessibility evidence after each action; detect half-complete state.
Add retry, pause, takeover, and human confirmation for failures.
Accept with at least three real desktop tasks without reading password vaults or changing system security settings.
en.gate: Three real desktop tasks complete and verify; no vault or system-security changes; every action is bounded; failures pause or hand over; the UI shows progress and evidence.

zh.title: 高风险 GUI 与 Stage 3 发布
zh.lead: 对不可逆或高影响的桌面动作建立完整影响说明、隔离执行、二次确认和补偿路径，然后才发布桌面操作员。
zh.outcome: 用户对不可逆或高影响桌面动作看到完整影响、二次确认和补偿方式；失败后不会留下未知的高风险状态。
steps: 建立隔离虚拟桌面，限制访问范围并记录快照。
列出不可逆动作清单和高风险审批矩阵。
在 Effect Preview 中展示目标、影响、不可逆性和补偿脚本。
实现桌面快照、失败恢复和半完成状态检测。
至少用 5 个代表性桌面任务验收，覆盖接管、高风险审批和恢复。
完成 Stage 3 安全、评测和运维文档，确认用户理解撤销或补偿方式。
zh.gate: 至少 5 个代表性桌面任务完成；接管和高风险审批可用；无密码库/系统设置越权；失败不留半完成高风险状态；用户理解如何撤销或补偿。
evidence: 高风险审批与动作清单

en.title: High-risk GUI and Stage 3 release
en.lead: Establish impact explanation, isolation, second confirmation, and compensation for irreversible or high-impact desktop actions before releasing the operator.
en.outcome: Users see full impact, second confirmation, and compensation for irreversible desktop actions; failure leaves no unknown high-risk state.
steps: Create an isolated virtual desktop with bounded access and snapshots.
Define the irreversible-action list and high-risk approval matrix.
Show target, impact, irreversibility, and compensation in Effect Preview.
Implement desktop snapshots, failure recovery, and half-complete detection.
Accept with at least five representative desktop tasks covering takeover, high-risk approval, and recovery.
Complete Stage 3 safety, evaluation, and operations documentation so users understand undo or compensation.
en.gate: Five representative desktop tasks complete; takeover and high-risk approval work; no vault or system-settings overreach; failure leaves no half-complete high-risk state; users understand undo/compensation.
